The '''revenant demon''' is a type of [[revenant]] that inhabits the [[Revenant Caves]], which is a PvP-enabled area that is part of the [[Wilderness]]. Like all revenants, they can restore their health when it falls below 50% and will react to a player's protection prayers; wearing a charged [[bracelet of ethereum]] will reduce all revenants' damage by 75%.

The [[Salve amulet]] can be a good option for killing revenants due to the damage bonus it provides while being easily replaceable, as [[PKing]] in the Revenant Caves is extremely common.

Revenant demons '''cannot''' be killed as an alternative for [[Lesser demon|lesser]] or [[greater demon]] [[Slayer task]]. In addition, demonbane weapons such as a [[scorching bow]] will not receive bonus damage against them.

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 25 June 2025
|update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat
|change = Revenant demons now have a 30% [[elemental weakness]] to [[wind spells]].
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 25 March 2026
|update = Easter 2026 & PvP QoL Improvements
|change = Revenants and the Revenant Maledictus will no longer invalidate Iron accounts from obtaining loot if another player attacks those NPCs. The Iron account will still only receive a drop if they are the MvP (player that dealt the most damage).
}}
{{Subject_changes
|date = 27 October 2021
|update = Revenant Caves & Deadman Changes
|change = 
* The revenant demon's respawn time was decreased from 75 [[ticks]] (45 seconds) to 50 ticks (30 seconds).
* The revenant's drop table was readjusted again.
* An additional spawn was added for each revenant.
* The revenant's healing mechanics were rebalanced.
}}
{{Subject_changes
|date = 13 January 2021
|update = God Wars Instancing and Soul Wars Improvements
|change = Revenants were made into [[Spectral (attribute)|spectral]] creatures.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 21 October 2020
|update = Halloween 2020
|change = 
*Increased amount of Revenants in the cave, and spread them over the entirety of the cave
*Combat zones modified to "singles-plus" - players can still fight revenants, but they can be attacked by another player while fighting them.
*Being skulled has less impact on drop rates
*A dwarf multicannon can no longer be set up anywhere within the caves
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 6 August 2020
|update = PVP Changes
|change = 
*[[Bracelet of Ethereum]] damage reduction lowered by 25% for a total of 75% damage reduction.
*The average value of the revenant drop table been reduced by around 20%.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 1 March 2018
|update = QoL Improvements & Deadman Permadeath Beta
|change = *The magic attack of the Revenants will now target several players at once. Up to 10 players stood on the same tile as the main target will be targeted with the magic attack. 
*The chances of rolling on the normal loot table have been increased slightly.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 21 February 2018
|update = Revenant Caves: Hotfix
|change = *Reduced overall value of revenant drops
*Dwarf multicannons can no longer be placed within the Revenant area of the caves
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 26 January 2018
|update = Wilderness Rejuvenation II & QoL Month
|change = *Increased the likelihood of landing on the normal loot table instead of coins.
*Removed some lesser valuable drops and increased quantities of regular loot.
*Tweaked various weightings across the normal loot table and all 100x drops have been removed.
*Added Ancient Statuettes to the drop table.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 30 November 2017
|update = Buffs, Deadman and Mythical Cape Designs
|change = *Revenants now correctly play their correct defend animations.
*The Slayer gem will now log kills of Revenants.
}}
